capabilities: Renumber H1-H4 headings in single-level or multi-level (1 / 1.1 / 1.1.1) modes
Regenerate headings from each section's body text using AI (emoji, topic, one-sentence summary)
Insert a batch of blank lines after the current paragraph
Move newly added image embeds into a subfolder and rewrite links on save
Clean up Markdown by completing code block languages, merging blank lines, padding blockquotes, and inserting or deleting horizontal rules
extras: The README is bilingual (full Chinese and English versions); auto-organizing images is off by default, as are all cleanup options except heading numbering, which always runs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to renumber headings and normalize spacing, code block languages, blockquote padding, horizontal rules, and image locations across a document in one step.

relations.evidence: AI heading generation supports six providers: claude / deepseek / gemini / gpt / qwen / kimi
relations.plugin: Claude / DeepSeek / Gemini / GPT / Qwen / Kimi

requires.name: API key for one of six AI providers (Claude / DeepSeek / Gemini / GPT / Qwen / Kimi)

summary: Markdown document organizer that renumbers H1-H4 headings and optionally completes code block languages, merges blank lines, pads blockquotes, and manages horizontal rules.
